camera.shot_scale_bias: long-held wides; the person is small inside the place

lens.dof: deep focus, the whole room equally present

lighting.practicals: a single lamp allowed to be the only warm thing

rules: frames held long after the action leaves them
doorways and windows frame the frame
composition.movement_of_subject: a person crosses the space in real time, unhurried

sound.ambience_bias: room tone, wind under the door, a tap somewhere else in the house

must_include: the shot is held without a cut
time is allowed to pass on screen
